verdict.rationale: Cooley's compensation and benefits practice page claims broad experience with compensation and benefits programs for startups through public companies. A community post notes Cooley GO content on equity incentive tax issues, so the firm plausibly designs employee equity programs. However, no cited page explicitly describes designing stock option plans, and none of the named local schemes appear in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit first-party pages on option plan design, any evidence of UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP or Indian ESOP schemes, and independent corroboration of equity-plan work.
